author: Alex O'Connor
description:
For early, ad-free access to videos, and to support the channel, subscribe to my Substack: https://www.alexoconnor.com.

To donate to my PayPal (thank you): http://www.paypal.me/cosmicskeptic.

 - VIDEO NOTES

@TommyEdisonXP is a blind YouTuber and radio presenter. He got his start online as the “Blind Film Critic”, reviewing movies despite being unable to see them, and thereby offering a unique angle on their storytelling.
